scope: Original report scalar/capture costs and original per-batch log lines only. Large IDs, per-token vectors and minimum-batch payloads are omitted. Differences are descriptive outer-scope remainder, not identified copy/compile time. Ranks are concurrent and not added. Partial groups do not have a final report. compute_tokens is the original full batch maximum and original_shared_prefix_token_slots still uses the original common MIN boundary. Their difference preserves legacy metadata accounting only, and is not the actual individual-row suffix slots, FA traffic or FLOPs. No production logging, parameter, threshold, GPU, model, Ray RPC or checkpoint operation.

field_semantics_source_audit.operation: Local source/previously captured scalar analysis only; no additional remote read or production/model operation
field_semantics_source_audit.nonzero_reward_events: reward_readout._prepare_episode counts active local response rows with float(row[rewards]) != 0. It does not count local unique trajectories, nonzero complete returns, or full task successes; native transport padding remains represented.
field_semantics_source_audit.complete_return: dt_training_batch prepares future returns on complete grouped trajectory responses before num_tests grouping and original DP partition. Worker attribute_prepared_batch reads data.batch[dt_complete_return] and forwards complete_returns to readout without recomputing on its response fragment.
field_semantics_source_audit.requests: Driver prefilters dt_complete_return != 0, active and nonempty response. Readout independently skips value == 0 or no policy positions before appending requests. Prefix bank sees only those appended requests. No G=0 prefix capture is established by events26 vs uniquehistories63.
field_semantics_source_audit.local_unique_histories: Prefix adapter canonicalizes its local nonzero-G response requests by traj_uid. DP partitions response rows, so a history can be present on a rank while its terminal nonzero raw reward response is on the other rank.
field_semantics_source_audit.first_group_consistency: rank0 events26 + rank1 events37 = 63. This is consistent with distributed response fragments of 63 histories; absence of UID lists prevents an independent actual cross-rank union count.
field_semantics_source_audit.policy_tokens: Sum of active response attention positions processed by _prepare_episode, prior to computing credit; includes native transport padding rows.
field_semantics_source_audit.nonzero_advantages: Count_nonzero of result dt_token_advantages values. Raw G nonzero and valid action tokens can still have zero DT advantage. The differences 96294-95816=478 and 109312-108835=477 are not missing policy-token rows inferred from these counters.
field_semantics_source_audit.legacy_metadata: compute_tokens uses original full batch max; original_shared_prefix_token_slots uses common MIN prefix, not individual-row prefix sum. Their difference is only compatible legacy metadata accounting, not actual row suffix compute.

producer_binding.scope: Current actual producer generated by adjacent producer.diff constructor factory-flags-only change; attribute_prepared_batch complete_return body unchanged
